name.zh: 阿肯色 7 号公路（风景 7 号路）

tagline.en: Louisiana line to the Ozarks through four geographic regions
tagline.zh: 自路易斯安那州界至欧扎克，穿越四个地理区

start.en: The Louisiana state line south of El Dorado
start.zh: 埃尔多拉多以南的路易斯安那州界

end.en: Harrison, at the junction of AR 7 with US 62 and US 412
end.zh: 哈里森，AR 7 与 US 62、US 412 交汇处

en: Scenic 7 crosses almost the whole of Arkansas from south to north and changes region four times doing it. It begins in the coastal plain: lowland rolling hills under dense pine, with bottomland hardwood along the river valleys.

South of Hot Springs it enters the Ouachita Mountains, which are unusual in North America for running east–west rather than north–south — wide valleys, farmland, timbered ridges. At Hot Springs itself the highway goes through the historic downtown in front of Bathhouse Row.

North of that comes the Arkansas River valley, the corridor that carried flatboats, keelboats, steamboats and the overland stage, and then the Ozarks: oak-hickory forest that turns yellow, orange and red against the pines in autumn, clear streams, limestone bluffs. The Arkansas Department of Transportation puts the designated byway at approximately 290 miles.
zh: 风景 7 号路自南向北几乎纵贯整个阿肯色，途中四度更换地理区。它始于沿海平原：茂密松林下的低地起伏丘陵，河谷沿线则是低洼硬木林。
温泉城以南，它进入沃希托山脉——这在北美颇为少见，其山脊呈东西走向而非南北走向，有宽阔的谷地、农田与林木覆盖的山脊。在温泉城本身，公路穿过历史街区，从浴室街前方经过。
再往北是阿肯色河谷，这条走廊曾承载平底船、龙骨船、蒸汽船与陆上驿马车；之后便是欧扎克：秋天里栎—山核桃林在松树映衬下转为黄、橙、红，溪水清澈，石灰岩崖壁林立。阿肯色交通部将指定风景道长度定为约 290 英里。

en: Highway 7 became Arkansas's first scenic byway in 1993, when the designation covered the stretch from Arkadelphia north to Harrison. That is the mountain half — the part that had always been the reason people drove the road.

In 1999 the designation was extended south, adding the highway from the Louisiana state line to Arkadelphia and bringing the byway to its present length of approximately 290 miles. The southern extension is a different sort of landscape and it is the part that gives Scenic 7 its claim to cross the state.

Beyond the byway's northern end the highway keeps going for about another twenty miles to Diamond City on Bull Shoals Lake, which is pastoral rather than scenic in the designated sense and carries no byway signing.
zh: 7 号公路于 1993 年成为阿肯色首条风景道，当时指定范围覆盖自阿肯色城北至哈里森的路段。那是山地的一半——历来正是人们驾车走这条路的理由。
1999 年，指定范围向南扩展，纳入自路易斯安那州界至阿肯色城的公路，使风景道达到今天约 290 英里的长度。南段延伸是另一种地貌，也正是它让风景 7 号路得以宣称纵贯全州。
越过风景道北端，公路继续约二十英里通往布尔肖尔斯湖畔的戴蒙德城；那一段是田园风光而非指定意义上的风景路段，也没有风景道标志。

en: The Ozark section north of Russellville is the one motorcyclists come for, and the reason is geometry rather than views: the road climbs and turns continuously through the Ozark National Forest between Dover, Jasper and Harrison.

It is also the section where services are thinnest. The towns are small, the descents are long, and the road passes close to the Buffalo National River, the first river protected as a unit of the national park system, with access points on side roads rather than on Highway 7 itself.

The southern half rewards a different pace. Petit Jean State Park sits off the route in the river valley, Hot Springs National Park is on it, and the coastal plain at the far south end is quiet pine-country driving of the kind the designation is not really about but which the 1999 extension formally included.
zh: 拉塞尔维尔以北的欧扎克路段是摩托车骑手前来的理由，原因在于线形而非风景：这条路在多佛、贾斯珀与哈里森之间穿越欧扎克国家森林，持续爬升与转弯。
这也是服务设施最稀疏的一段。城镇很小，下坡很长，道路紧邻布法罗国家河——美国第一条被划入国家公园体系加以保护的河流——其入口设在支路上，而非 7 号公路本身。
南半段适合另一种节奏。小让山州立公园位于河谷中、略离路线，温泉国家公园就在路上，而最南端的沿海平原是安静的松林驾驶——这类风景并非该指定的本意，却被 1999 年的延伸正式纳入。

figures.source: Arkansas Department of Transportation, Scenic Byways (Beautification Section)

value.zh: 1993 年，自阿肯色城至哈里森——阿肯色首条风景道

figures.source: Arkansas Department of Transportation, Scenic Byways (Beautification Section)

value.zh: 1999 年，纳入路易斯安那州界至阿肯色城路段

why.en: ArDOT publishes the byway length but not a route total for the highway beyond Harrison, and no state-published figure for the full AR 7 could be verified this session.
why.zh: 阿肯色交通部公布了风景道长度，但未公布哈里森以北公路的路线总里程；本次未能查证到该州公布的 AR 7 全线数据。

timeline.en: Highway 7 from Arkadelphia to Harrison becomes Arkansas's first scenic byway.
timeline.zh: 自阿肯色城至哈里森的 7 号公路成为阿肯色首条风景道。

timeline.en: The byway is extended south to the Louisiana state line.
timeline.zh: 风景道向南延伸至路易斯安那州界。
